sentences.en: Six, five, four, three, two, one.
Cast your mind back to the late 1990s.
sentences.zh: 把你的思绪拉回到20世纪90年代末。

sentences.en: We have ignition and we have liftoff of NASA's Mars Climate Orbiter
sentences.zh: 点火成功，NASA的火星气候探测器顺利升空，

sentences.en: as we continue to explore the mysteries of the Red Planet.
sentences.zh: 我们将继续探索这颗红色星球的奥秘。

sentences.en: It's the late 20th century, and as the threat of Y2K and rap metal crossover
sentences.zh: 那是20世纪末，当时人们对“千年虫”危机和说唱金属音乐的担忧

sentences.en: loom large in people's minds, and NASA satellite blasts off towards Mars.
sentences.zh: 笼罩在心头，而NASA的一颗卫星正向火星发射。

sentences.en: That's producer Joel Werner from the Sum of All Parts podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 那是来自《万物之和》播客的制作人乔尔·沃纳。

sentences.en: 20 seconds after liftoff, everything continues to go well.
sentences.zh: 升空20秒后，一切进展顺利。
所以这颗重达338公斤的卫星……

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah, we'll get to that.
sentences.zh: 是是是，我们一会儿会说到这个。

sentences.en: So the satellite weighing 338 kilograms hurtles through space towards the distant planet.
sentences.zh: 这颗重达338公斤的卫星在太空中疾驰，飞向遥远的行星。

sentences.en: It takes nearly a year to get there, and when it gets close,
sentences.zh: 它花了近一年时间才到达那里，当它靠近时，

sentences.en: the satellite fires its main engine to go into orbit around Mars.
sentences.zh: 卫星启动了主引擎，准备进入火星轨道。

sentences.en: Up until that point, all data from the spacecraft appeared normal.
sentences.zh: 在那之前，航天器传回的所有数据看起来都很正常。

sentences.en: The engine burn begins just as the spacecraft disappears behind Mars.
sentences.zh: 就在航天器消失在火星背面时，引擎开始点火。

sentences.en: Mission control waits for it to reappear, and they wait, and wait, and wait.
sentences.zh: 任务控制中心等待着它重新出现，他们等啊，等啊，一直等。
但航天器再也没有出现。

sentences.en: The Mars Climate Orbiter is loSt.
sentences.zh: 火星气候探测器失联了。

sentences.en: I'm sorry to report that we have a serious problem with the Mars Climate Orbiter.
sentences.zh: 我很遗憾地报告，我们的火星气候探测器出了严重问题。

sentences.en: We may, in fact, be facing a loss of mission.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们可能面临任务失败。

sentences.en: We believe the spacecraft came in at a lower altitude than we had intended,
sentences.zh: 我们认为航天器进入的高度比我们预期的要低，

sentences.en: and that depending on how low that was and it's something we're still going to confirm,
sentences.zh: 至于具体低了多少，这还需要我们进一步确认，

sentences.en: it potentially resulted in the loss of the mission.
sentences.zh: 这很可能导致了任务的失败。

sentences.en: Scientists at NASA began to pore over the data,
sentences.zh: NASA的科学家们开始仔细研究数据，

sentences.en: looking for clues as to what might have gone wrong.
And before long, they figure it out.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，他们就找到了原因。

sentences.en: The spacecraft was supposed to approach the planet
sentences.zh: 航天器本应以150公里，也就是93英里的高度

sentences.en: at an altitude of 150 kilometers, or 93 miles,
when, in fact, its approach had been lower.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，它的接近高度更低。

sentences.en: The post-mortem at NASA found that a pretty simple error was to blame.
sentences.zh: NASA的事后调查发现，罪魁祸首是一个非常简单的错误。

sentences.en: The NASA investigative board confirmed the cause of the failure
sentences.zh: NASA调查委员会确认了这起耗资1.25亿美元的航天器

sentences.en: The NASA team at Jet Propulsion Laboratory assumed
sentences.zh: 喷气推进实验室的NASA团队假设

sentences.en: they were using the metric system to measure rocket firings.
sentences.zh: 他们在测量火箭点火时使用的是公制单位。

sentences.en: NASA was using the metric system,
the international standard, for its calculations.
sentences.zh: 也就是国际标准单位进行计算。

sentences.en: But one of their contractors was using U.S.
sentences.zh: 但他们的承包商之一使用的是美国

sentences.en: the proper term for the American system of inches, pounds, and gallons.
sentences.zh: 这是对美国所用的英寸、磅和加仑系统的正式称呼。

sentences.en: Years of planning, hundreds of millions of dollars literally up in smoke,
sentences.zh: 多年的规划，数亿美元的投入，就这样化为乌有，

sentences.en: burned up in the Martian atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 在火星大气层中烧毁了。

sentences.en: And all because someone did the right calculation in the wrong units.
sentences.zh: 而这一切仅仅是因为有人用错误的单位做了正确的计算。

sentences.en: This wasn't the only time a conversion error resulted in disaster.
sentences.zh: 这并不是唯一一次因单位换算错误导致灾难的事件。

sentences.en: In the early 80s, an airliner ran out of fuel mid-flight
sentences.zh: 80年代初，一架客机在飞行途中耗尽了燃油，

sentences.en: after a metric conversion error and had to make an emergency landing.
sentences.zh: 原因也是公制换算错误，不得不进行紧急迫降。

sentences.en: And in 2001, the LA Zoo loaned a 75-year-old Galapagos tortoise
sentences.zh: 2001年，洛杉矶动物园将一只75岁的加拉帕戈斯象龟

sentences.en: to an animal management program at a local college.
sentences.zh: 借给当地一所大学的动物管理项目。

sentences.en: The zoo warned that Clarence, the tortoise, was big and needed an enclosure for an animal weighing 250 kilograMs.
sentences.zh: 动物园警告说，这只叫克拉伦斯的象龟体型巨大，需要一个能容纳250公斤重动物的围栏。

sentences.en: But the college thought they meant 250 pounds, which is only 113 kilograms,
sentences.zh: 但校方以为他们指的是250磅，也就是只有113公斤，
大约只有它实际体重的一半。

sentences.en: His first night in his new home, Clarence destroyed it.
sentences.zh: 在它新家的第一晚，克拉伦斯就把围栏拆了。

sentences.en: But these kinds of failures haven't been enough to get the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但这些失败案例还不足以促使美国

sentences.en: to switch over to the measurement system
sentences.zh: 改用世界上绝大多数国家

sentences.en: used by the vast majority of the world.
We Americans measure things our own way, in units that are basically inscrutable to non-Americans,
sentences.zh: 我们美国人有自己的一套测量方式，单位对非美国人来说基本无法理解，

sentences.en: nearly all of whom have been brought up in an all-metric environment.
sentences.zh: 而他们几乎都是在全公制环境中长大的。

sentences.en: They use meters, liters, and kilograms, not yards, gallons, and pounds.
sentences.zh: 他们用米、升和公斤，而不是码、加仑和磅。

sentences.en: You might have noticed that I'm a non-American myself.
sentences.zh: 你可能已经注意到，我自己就不是美国人。

sentences.en: And while I've never lost a spacecraft to a distant planet,
sentences.zh: 虽然我从未因为单位问题弄丢过飞往遥远行星的航天器，

sentences.en: I have run into other problems, like ordering way too much deli meat.
sentences.zh: 但我确实遇到过其他麻烦，比如买熟食时买得太多了。

sentences.en: Too much deli meat is never a problem, Joel.
sentences.zh: 买太多熟食从来都不是问题，乔尔。

sentences.en: for a couple of years, and while culturally a lot came easy,
sentences.zh: 虽然文化上很多东西很容易适应，

sentences.en: I never really adjusted to your measurement system.
sentences.zh: 但我始终无法适应你们的计量系统。

sentences.en: Australia, where I'm from, has been a metric country for over 40 years.
sentences.zh: 我来自澳大利亚，那里使用公制已经超过40年了。
我是伴随着公制长大的。

sentences.en: I don't really have a sense of how much half a pound weighs,
sentences.zh: 我真的没法理解半磅到底有多重，

sentences.en: or how warm 60 degrees Fahrenheit is.
sentences.zh: 或者华氏60度到底有多暖和。

sentences.en: And two years wasn't enough to change that.
sentences.zh: 两年时间不足以改变这一点。

sentences.en: So when I lived in the States, I'd routinely head out in cold weather without a jacket,
sentences.zh: 所以当我在美国生活时，我经常在寒冷的天气里不穿外套就出门，

sentences.en: or come home with too much bacon.
sentences.zh: 或者回家时带了太多的培根。

sentences.en: So why, with so many industries, and people like Joel crossing borders with so much fluidity,
sentences.zh: 那么，既然有这么多行业，像乔尔这样的人也如此频繁地跨越国界，

sentences.en: not fully committed to the system the rest of the world uses?
sentences.zh: 还没有完全采用世界其他国家使用的系统呢？

sentences.en: As you might guess, it's complicated.
sentences.zh: 你可能猜到了，这很复杂。

sentences.en: So the metric system has a kind of complicated history in the United States.
sentences.zh: 公制在美国有着一段复杂的历史。

sentences.en: This is Stephen Mim, a history professor at the University of Georgia,
sentences.zh: 这位是佐治亚大学的历史学教授斯蒂芬·米姆，

sentences.en: and the author of a forthcoming book on the history of standardization in the United States.
sentences.zh: 他即将出版一本关于美国标准化历史的书。

sentences.en: It's in the 1790s when the United States was first fumbling around toward fulfilling the constitutional mandate
sentences.zh: 18世纪90年代，美国首次摸索着履行宪法授权，

sentences.en: to create a uniform system of weights and measures.
sentences.zh: 建立统一的度量衡系统。

sentences.en: The metric system was, at that point, just a glimmer in the eye of a bunch of French revolutionaries.
sentences.zh: 当时，公制系统在法国革命者眼中还只是一个模糊的构想。

sentences.en: And there was some discussion at the time, led by Thomas Jefferson,
sentences.zh: 当时在托马斯·杰斐逊的领导下，确实有过一些讨论，

sentences.en: adopt a decimal-based system kind of like the eventual metric system.
sentences.zh: 采用一种类似于后来公制系统的十进制系统。

sentences.en: But the idea didn't gain much traction.
sentences.zh: 但这个想法并没有引起太大的反响。

sentences.en: So when it came time to systematize American weights and measures,
sentences.zh: 所以当需要系统化美国的度量衡时，

sentences.en: we ultimately threw our lot with what we were working with at the time,
sentences.zh: 我们最终还是选择了当时正在使用的那套，

sentences.en: which was the bushels and pounds and feet and so forth.
sentences.zh: 也就是蒲式耳、磅、英尺等等。

sentences.en: America had inherited this old system of measurement from the British.
sentences.zh: 美国从英国继承了这套古老的测量系统。

sentences.en: It had its roots in Roman and Anglo-Saxon units,
sentences.zh: 它起源于罗马和盎格鲁-撒克逊单位，

sentences.en: and then evolved over thousands of years before American independence.
sentences.zh: 并在美国独立前演变了数千年。

sentences.en: But around the same time, French revolutionaries were heading in a new direction.
sentences.zh: 但大约在同一时间，法国革命者正朝着一个新的方向前进。

sentences.en: They opted to throw out their old system, which they found displeasingly irrational,
sentences.zh: 他们选择抛弃旧系统，因为他们觉得那套系统极其不合理，

sentences.en: and switch it for a new system, the metric system.
sentences.zh: 并改用一套新系统，即公制系统。

sentences.en: The metric system is a decimal system, meaning it relies on multiples of 10.
sentences.zh: 公制是十进制系统，意味着它依赖于10的倍数。

sentences.en: 10 millimetres become one centimetre, 100 centimetres become one metre, and so on.
sentences.zh: 10毫米等于1厘米，100厘米等于1米，以此类推。

sentences.en: The French began promoting the system internationally,
sentences.zh: 法国人开始在国际上推广这套系统，

sentences.en: arguing that it would encourage trade and bring the world together.
sentences.zh: 认为它能促进贸易并让世界更加紧密。

sentences.en: By the mid-19th century, there was a growing adoption of the metric system worldwide.
sentences.zh: 到19世纪中叶，公制系统在全世界范围内得到了越来越多的采用。

sentences.en: And as the metric system spread, some people in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 随着公制的普及，美国的一些人
比如教育工作者和科学家们。

sentences.en: to get with the program and officially go metric.
sentences.zh: 能跟上潮流，正式改用公制。

sentences.en: It lends itself really well to scientific research and inquiry.
sentences.zh: 它非常适合科学研究和探索。

sentences.en: And for educators, it's real easy to teach students, and it makes a lot of sense.
sentences.zh: 对于教育工作者来说，它很容易教授给学生，而且非常有逻辑。

sentences.en: customary system did not sit well with a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 习惯单位系统让很多人感到不适。

sentences.en: And the resistance came from a few different quarters, some of which overlapped.
sentences.zh: 这种阻力来自几个不同的群体，其中一些还有重叠。

sentences.en: But the most interesting was a group of astronomers, theologians, and cranks.
sentences.zh: 但最有趣的是一群天文学家、神学家和怪人。

sentences.en: And keep in mind that those categories, which we consider separate and distinct today, were not at this time.
sentences.zh: 请记住，在当时，我们今天认为截然不同的这些类别，在当时并非如此。

sentences.en: And so those people came to believe that there was a biblical basis for the inch,
sentences.zh: 这些人开始相信英寸有其圣经依据，

sentences.en: and that that biblical basis was marked in the Great Pyramid of Giza, in the architecture of that pyramid.
sentences.zh: 而且这种圣经依据被标记在吉萨大金字塔的建筑结构中。

sentences.en: This theory got more and more elaborate and gained a lot of followers,
sentences.zh: 这个理论变得越来越复杂，并获得了许多追随者，

sentences.en: as the astronomers and theologians combined scientific arguments with other wild and nonsensical ideas.
sentences.zh: 因为天文学家和神学家将科学论点与其他疯狂且荒谬的想法结合在了一起。

sentences.en: And welded it all together into what was for many people a compelling argument
sentences.zh: 并将这一切融合在一起，对许多人来说，这成了一个令人信服的论点，

sentences.en: that to abandon the inch and then all of the other weights and measures was to go against God's will.
sentences.zh: 即放弃英寸以及所有其他度量衡就是违背上帝的旨意。

sentences.en: So, science and education with this newer, shinier measurement system
sentences.zh: 所以，一边是科学和教育界支持这种更新、更闪亮的测量系统，

sentences.en: versus religious zealots clinging to what they know, fearful of change.
sentences.zh: 另一边是宗教狂热分子固守已知事物，害怕改变。

sentences.en: It's a good story, but it's only part of the story.
sentences.zh: 这是一个好故事，但这只是故事的一部分。

sentences.en: in the 1870s, the real core resistance came from a different group entirely,
sentences.zh: 真正的核心阻力来自一个完全不同的群体，

sentences.en: some of the most innovative industrialists of their day.
sentences.zh: 即当时最具创新精神的实业家们。

sentences.en: The answer lies with engineers and with machine tool industry in the late 19th and 20th centuries,
sentences.zh: 答案在于19世纪末和20世纪的工程师和机床行业，

sentences.en: who had tooled up enormous, vast factories and a vast industrial base
sentences.zh: 他们已经装备了庞大、广阔的工厂和巨大的工业基础，

sentences.en: that by the 1870s sat at the heart of what was now the largest economy in the world.
sentences.zh: 到19世纪70年代，这些工厂已成为当时世界最大经济体的核心。

sentences.en: This vast industrial system included everything from lathes to devices for cutting screw threads,
sentences.zh: 这个庞大的工业系统包括从车床到切削螺纹的各种设备，

sentences.en: and it was all based on the inch.
sentences.zh: 而这一切都是基于英寸的。

sentences.en: The manufacturers did not want to retool.
sentences.zh: 制造商们不想重新配置设备。

sentences.en: They said it would be way too expensive.
They also argued that there was an intuitiveness to the customary system.
sentences.zh: 他们还认为习惯单位系统具有直观性。

sentences.en: You have an inch, you have a half inch, a quarter inch, eighth inch, 16, and so on.
sentences.zh: 你有一英寸，有半英寸，四分之一英寸，八分之一英寸，十六分之一，以此类推。

sentences.en: That kind of division on the shop floor, maybe not for a scientist,
sentences.zh: 这种在车间里的划分方式，对科学家来说可能不重要，

sentences.en: but on the shop floor makes a huge amount of sense.
sentences.zh: 但在车间里却非常有意义。

sentences.en: And it's very simple, it's very straightforward, it's very easy to learn,
sentences.zh: 它非常简单，非常直接，非常容易学习，

sentences.en: and it's very easy to build machines around that concept.
sentences.zh: 而且围绕这个概念制造机器也非常容易。

sentences.en: And all because everything is simply doubled or halved.
sentences.zh: 这一切仅仅是因为所有东西都可以简单地加倍或减半。

sentences.en: And the arguments of these late 19th century industrialists proved incredibly influential.
sentences.zh: 这些19世纪末实业家的论点被证明具有极大的影响力。

sentences.en: So to put this into context, this would be like today,
sentences.zh: 所以，把这个放到背景中来看，这就像今天，

sentences.en: the tech sector and the titans of the tech sector pushing back and saying,
sentences.zh: 科技行业和科技巨头们站出来反对并说，

sentences.en: you know, metric system over our dead bodies.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，公制系统除非我们死掉，否则别想进来。

sentences.en: And so the industrialists and the cranks win this round.
sentences.zh: 于是，实业家和怪人们赢得了这一轮。

sentences.en: Subsequent generations make attempts to introduce the metric system to the US,
sentences.zh: 后来的几代人曾尝试将公制系统引入美国，

sentences.en: and they are met with subsequent generations of resistance.
sentences.zh: 但他们也遭到了后代人的抵制。

sentences.en: Congress repeatedly brings up legislation to make the metric system not just legal, but mandatory.
sentences.zh: 国会反复提出立法，不仅要使公制系统合法，还要使其成为强制性标准。

sentences.en: And each time the legislation goes down in flames.
sentences.zh: 但每一次，这些立法都以失败告终。

sentences.en: But then in the 1970s, about 100 years after the first big push for metrication,
sentences.zh: 然而到了20世纪70年代，也就是第一次大规模推行公制化约100年后，

sentences.en: and on the back of a wave of metrication around the world,
sentences.zh: 在全球公制化浪潮的推动下，

sentences.en: another attempt is made to bring the metric system to the US.
sentences.zh: 美国又一次尝试引入公制系统。

sentences.en: And this time, it really catches on.
sentences.zh: 而这一次，它真的流行起来了。

sentences.en: Congress actually passes an act in 1975 declaring the metric system
sentences.zh: 国会实际上在1975年通过了一项法案，宣布公制系统

sentences.en: the preferred system of weights and measures for the United States trade and commerce.
sentences.zh: 是美国贸易和商业的首选度量衡系统。

sentences.en: And then President Gerald Ford follows it up with an executive order.
sentences.zh: 随后，杰拉尔德·福特总统又发布了一项行政命令。

sentences.en: In both cases, the adoption of the metric system is deemed voluntary.
sentences.zh: 在这两种情况下，公制系统的采用都被视为自愿的。

sentences.en: But the government really tries to make it happen.
sentences.zh: 但政府确实在努力促成此事。

sentences.en: Take 10 Americans to learn the metric way
sentences.zh: 带上10个美国人来学习公制方法

sentences.en: It's a simple system based on 10s that you can start today
sentences.zh: 这是一个基于10的简单系统，你今天就可以开始使用

sentences.en: Efficient, more accurate, more universal too
sentences.zh: 更高效、更准确，也更通用

sentences.en: It's good for our economy, our country, and for you
sentences.zh: 这对我们的经济、我们的国家，以及对你都有好处

sentences.en: The US Office of Education ran PSAs like this one.
sentences.zh: 美国教育部当时播放了像这样的公益广告。

sentences.en: People started pinning take-me-to-your-liter buttons to their jackets
sentences.zh: 人们开始在夹克上别上“带我去看公升”的徽章

sentences.en: There was a popular poster sold that featured a woman in a bikini
sentences.zh: 当时有一张很受欢迎的海报，上面印着一位穿着比基尼的女性，

sentences.en: with the slogan Think Metric above her
sentences.zh: 上方写着“考虑公制”的标语，

sentences.en: and her measurements in centimetres below
sentences.zh: 下方则是她以厘米为单位的三围数据，

sentences.en: Turns out you can be sexist in metric too
sentences.zh: 事实证明，你在公制里也可以搞性别歧视

sentences.en: But the 1975 Metric Conversion Act didn't really have any teeth
